claims.object_text: Ca2+ permeability of AMPA receptors depends on presence and Q/R editing state of GluA2
claims.quote: AMPA receptors are Ca2+-permeable if they lack the GluA2 subunit or if GluA2 is unedited at a single nucleic acid, known as the Q/R site.

claims.object_text: mouse engineered with a point mutation in the intronic ECS of Gria2 (GluA2)
claims.quote: In this study, we examined mice engineered with a point mutation in the intronic editing complementary sequence (ECS) of the GluA2 gene, Gria2.

claims.object_text: reduction in GluA2 RNA editing at the Q/R site (~20%)
claims.quote: Mice heterozygous for the ECS mutation (named GluA2+/ECS(G)) had a ~ 20% reduction in GluA2 RNA editing at the Q/R site.
